svg.title: ContextWeaver NextGen architecture atlas
svg.desc: Current ContextWeaver architecture from collaborative Workspaces and four Studios through Cerebro governance, Weave capabilities, durable runtime, evidence, Capability Operator, and cloud-neutral Loom infrastructure.
svg.text: Cerebro governs. Weave composes. Loom runs anywhere. Evidence follows every lifecycle stage.

g.text: CEREBRO - Understand, govern, compile, orchestrate, prove
RUNTIME - Rehearse, execute durably, collect evidence

svg.text: Identity | Policy | Approval | Audit | Evidence span every layer
